title: run skill does not verify build compiles before tagging candidate
description: During run 004c6afb-9d83-474f-bc34-1046fffa1cfd (signal a1000094), the Verify phase completed and a candidate tag was created without ever running `cargo build` or equivalent. The implemented code contained a compile error (`spec_path_arg` used in scope where only `resolved_spec_path` exists). The error was only discovered post-run when the user attempted to use the build. The spec.skill.md Verify phase checks rubric adherence but has no step that actually compiles the project.
proposed_resolution: Add a mandatory build-verification step to the spec.skill.md Verify phase: run `mcp__moeb__run_command` with the project's build command (e.g. `cargo build`) and treat a non-zero exit as a blocking Verify failure. The candidate tag must not be created if the build fails.
